notablePrerequisites:
Kazandu Tuskcaller does not have summoning sickness.
Kazandu Tuskcaller has at least two level counters on it.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Activate Kazandu Tuskcaller by tapping it, creating a 3/3 Elephant creature token.
When the Elephant enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Kazandu Tuskcaller.
Repeat.
